steps: Progress through Ward 13 until you reach the tutorial boss area.
Defeat the Root Mantis — this is the first boss fight in the game.
At the start of the game, pick one of the starter Archetypes: Handler, Hunter, Medic, Challenger, or Gunslinger.
This unlocks automatically during character creation.
Traits are unlocked by completing specific actions, finding items, or defeating bosses.
Many can be found naturally during the first world you visit.
Defeat a boss and collect its crafting material.
Speak to McCabe in Ward 13 and craft a Weapon Mod from boss materials.
Progress through any of the main worlds (Losomn, N'Erud, Yaesha).
Defeat the final boss of that world to earn this achievement.
Progress the main story until you reach the Labyrinth.
Defeat the Labyrinth Sentinel boss.
Use cover to avoid its beam attacks and focus fire during vulnerable phases.
Collect a Boss Material drop after defeating any boss.
Visit McCabe in Ward 13 to craft a weapon using the material plus Lumenite Crystals and Scrap.
Earn Trait Points by defeating bosses and leveling up your Archetype.
Spend 10 points in a single Trait at the Trait menu.
The Flautist (Pan Flautist) can appear in Yaesha.
Explore until you encounter them — they play a flute and offer dialogue.
Due to procedural generation, you may need to reroll Yaesha to find them.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Flautist appears in the overworld areas of Yaesha. If you don't see them, reroll Adventure Mode.

steps: Reach level 10 on your primary Archetype to unlock the second Archetype slot.
Acquire a second Archetype Engram and equip it in the second slot.
On N'Erud in Story Mode, the Custodian is found inside a giant statue holding a ball of light in the Phantom Wasteland — the AI companion points this out when you get close.
Leave the starting zone into the Phantom Wasteland and head for that statue; the Custodian is waiting inside.

If you missed him, complete N'Erud in Story Mode, then reroll Adventure Mode until the starting point is Seekers Rest and run it again. Zone names vary between seeds, so other reports place him in Abyssal Rift instead.
Nimue appears in Losomn. She is a large blue figure resting in a chamber.
Explore Losomn until you find Nimue's Retreat — interact with her.
Find a Relic Fragment Capacity item (dropped by certain bosses or found in dungeons).
Use it to increase your maximum relic charges.
Special enemies are the elite glowing enemies that appear during exploration.
Defeat 100 of them across all your playthroughs — cumulative.
Collect Iron and other upgrade materials from exploring and enemies.
Visit the upgrade station in Ward 13 and upgrade any standard weapon to +10.
Play with any Archetype equipped and earn XP from defeating enemies.
Reaching level 10 unlocks the second Archetype slot and this achievement.

achievements.name: Equal Measures
achievements.description: Receive an Alignment Reading from Meidra.

steps: Find Meidra in Yaesha — she sits in a forest clearing.
Answer her moral questions to receive an alignment reading (Doe or Ravager).
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Your answers determine your alignment (Doe = peaceful, Ravager = aggressive). Each gives a different reward.

steps: Boss weapons require Lumenite Crystals and special materials to upgrade.
Collect enough materials and upgrade any boss weapon to +5 at Ward 13.
Secret Archetypes include Explorer, Summoner, Archon, and Engineer.
Each requires finding a specific hidden item and bringing it to Wallace in Ward 13.
Explorer: complete all main biomes. Archon: requires a very specific gear build.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Summoner is the easiest secret archetype — buy the Old Whistle from the shop in Yaesha and bring it to Wallace.
Reddit tip: The Archon requires wearing very specific gear and trait combos simultaneously. Look up the exact setup.

steps: The Nightweaver is a boss in Losomn's Tormented Asylum area.
This is a two-phase fight. Phase 1: fight the shadowy form. Phase 2: fight the physical form.
Bring fire or bleed damage for extra effectiveness.
The Fae Imposter (Faelin/Faerin) is a boss in Losomn's Council Chamber.
You must choose which Fae to side with — the one you oppose becomes the boss.
Due to procedural generation, you may need to reroll to get this encounter.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Siding with Faelin or Faerin gives different rewards. Reroll Adventure Mode to fight the other one.

achievements.name: Was This Supposed To Happen?
achievements.description: Acquire a World Boss's Alternate Reward.

steps: Many world bosses have alternate kill methods that yield different loot.
For example: destroy specific body parts before the boss dies, or complete special conditions.
Check wiki guides for each boss's alternate reward condition.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The easiest alternate kill is shooting off the Nightweaver's brace during phase 2 before killing her.
Reddit tip: Most bosses have an alternate — check the Remnant 2 wiki for all alternate kill methods.
warnings: Alternate kills are missable within a run. If you miss it, you must reroll the world/adventure to try again.

steps: Many Faces is a boss in Yaesha.
The fight involves multiple mask phases with different attacks per phase.
Focus on learning each mask's pattern and adapt your positioning.
The Ravager is a wolf-like boss in Yaesha's Forbidden Grove.
You can choose to fight it, play the lullaby to calm it, or feed it the Doe.
Each choice gives different rewards and affects the Doe/Ravager storyline.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: To get this achievement you MUST fight and kill the Ravager. Don't play the flute or feed it the Doe.
warnings: If you calm the Ravager with the lullaby, you won't get this achievement. You must choose to fight.

steps: The Guardian is a major boss in N'Erud.
This is a large mechanical boss with devastating AoE attacks.
Stay mobile and target its weak points when exposed.

achievements.name: The Web
achievements.description: Obtain an Item From the Nightweaver's Web.

steps: In Losomn's Tormented Asylum, find the Nightweaver's Web blocking items.
You need the Stone-Carved Doll to cut through the web.
Interact with the web while holding the doll to retrieve the item.
Aberrations are rare, powerful enemies that spawn randomly in dungeons.
They have a distinctive red/purple aura and are much tougher than normal enemies.
Defeat 10 total across all playthroughs — cumulative.
Continue hunting Aberrations across multiple runs.
They appear more frequently at higher difficulties.
Defeat 25 total — this takes time as spawns are semi-random.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Run Apocalypse difficulty dungeons — Aberrations spawn more frequently there.
Reddit tip: Aberrations can drop rare loot including unique mutators.

achievements.name: Forever is a Long Time Coming

steps: Complete all three main worlds and progress to the final area.
Defeat Annihilation, the final boss of the base game.
This is a multi-phase fight — bring your best gear and be patient.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Annihilation has a devastating teleport + melee combo. Learn the dodge timing or you'll get one-shot.
Reddit tip: The fight is easier with a team, but solo is very doable with the right build.

steps: Tal'Ratha is a boss in N'Erud.
You can choose to fight Tal'Ratha normally OR let him eat you for an alternate fight (Tal'Ratha Metaphysical).
Each version drops different rewards.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Let him eat you for the alternate version — it's a trippy fight and gives a different weapon material.

steps: Scrap is the main currency — earned from killing enemies and selling items.
Accumulate 50,000 total (lifetime, not held at once).
Traits are unlocked by exploring, completing events, and defeating bosses.
Collect 10 unique traits across your playthroughs.

achievements.name: Bad Moon Rising
achievements.description: Craft an Item at the Blood Moon Altar.

steps: In Losomn, wait for a Blood Moon event (the sky turns red).
Find the Blood Moon Altar in the Losomn overworld during this event.
Use Blood Moon Essence (found during Blood Moon) to craft an item.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Blood Moons are semi-random. Rest at a checkpoint and re-enter the area to try to trigger one.
Reddit tip: The Blood Moon Altar sells unique items not available elsewhere.

steps: Defeat the Labyrinth Sentinel boss to unlock the area.
Proceed through the next portal. You end up talking to a giant eye called The Keeper, who gives you the Biome Portal Key on completion of the conversation.
Collect Leto's Stash from the same area — it holds the Chicago Typewriter armour. The trophy pops as you pick the armour up.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: It has been reported as host-only in co-op, though others unlocked it as a guest after clearing the Labyrinth solo.

steps: Collect 15 unique firearms. Guns are found as loot, crafted from boss materials, or purchased.
You'll naturally find many across a full playthrough.

achievements.name: Tall Tales
achievements.description: Listen to All of Mudtooth's Stories.

steps: Mudtooth is an NPC in Ward 13 near the campfire.
Talk to him repeatedly and exhaust all his stories. There are many — keep talking.
Each story also rewards a Trait unlock.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: He has a LOT of stories. Keep sitting down and talking to him until he repeats himself.
Reddit tip: Some stories only unlock after you've visited certain worlds.

steps: Collect 10 unique melee weapons from exploration, boss crafting, and purchases.
May require multiple playthroughs or Adventure Mode rerolls.
Mutators are attachments that add effects to weapons.
Upgrade any Mutator to its maximum level (+10) using Lumenite and Scrap.
Boss weapons require Lumenite Crystals and rare materials to upgrade.
Max out any boss weapon to +10. This requires significant material farming.

achievements.name: No One Should Have All That Power

steps: Standard weapons go up to +20 using Iron, Forged Iron, Galvanized Iron, and Hardened Iron.
Higher upgrade tiers require materials from harder difficulty levels.
You'll likely need to farm Veteran or Apocalypse difficulty for top-tier materials.
Accumulate 100,000 total Scrap (lifetime earnings).
Selling duplicate materials and unused items helps speed this up.

achievements.name: Carnage in C-Minor
achievements.description: Play a Secret Song on the Water Harp.

steps: The Water Harp is a puzzle in Losomn.
You need to find hidden symbols that correspond to the harp's pegs.
Set the pegs to the correct positions and pull the lever to play the song.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The symbols are found on the walls nearby. The solution varies per playthrough due to procedural generation.
Reddit tip: Playing the secret song opens a hidden room with unique loot.

steps: Travel to the Cathedral of Omens and wait for a Blood Moon in the sky. If it does not appear, leave and return — or bounce off the yellow portal — to reroll until one shows.
Once the moon is up, pull the mechanism that opens the door on your right, the one with the two treasure chests.
Directly in front of those chests is a trapdoor leading down into the Blood Moon room.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Both the Cathedral of Omens and the Imperial Gardens work. Adventure Mode is the fallback if you do not have the Imperial Gardens in your Campaign.

achievements.name: Maxed Out!
achievements.description: Acquire the Max Number of Trait Points.

steps: The max Trait Point cap is 65 (increased from 60 with updates).
Earn points from Tomes of Knowledge (found in worlds) and beating bosses.
Requires multiple playthroughs/rerolls to find enough Tomes.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Adventure Mode rerolls are the fastest way to farm Tomes of Knowledge. Each world has several.

achievements.name: Only Human
achievements.description: Defeat a Boss in Single-Player Without Taking Any Damage.

steps: Must be done solo (no co-op partners).
Pick an easy boss like the Root Mantis or a mini-boss you're comfortable with.
Learn the attack patterns completely and defeat it without taking a single hit.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The easiest boss for this is the Root Mantis tutorial fight. Roll a new character to attempt it fresh.
Reddit tip: Summoner builds can tank hits for you via summons — your character just can't take damage.
warnings: Any damage at all voids the achievement for that fight. Status effects (bleed, burn) also count as damage.

steps: Relics are special healing items found from bosses, events, and hidden locations.
Collect 10 unique relics. Requires exploring multiple world variations.
Collect 30 unique firearms. This requires multiple Campaign and Adventure Mode runs.
Craft boss weapons and find hidden guns in side dungeons.
Collect 20 unique melee weapons across all runs.
Boss melee weapons, event rewards, and hidden drops all count.
Requires thorough exploration and multiple rerolls.
Craft 15 unique Weapon Mods at McCabe's workshop in Ward 13.
Each boss material can make either a weapon or a mod — choose mods for this achievement.
Collect 20 unique Traits from events, bosses, puzzles, and NPC interactions.
Requires thorough exploration and multiple world rerolls.
The One True King is the final boss of The Awakened King DLC.
Progress through the DLC storyline in Losomn to reach him.
This is a challenging multi-phase fight. Bring your best gear.

achievements.name: A Foul Feast
achievements.description: Deliver Leftovers to a Reluctant Recipient.

steps: In The Awakened King DLC, find the Leftovers item.
Deliver it to the specific NPC who doesn't want it.
This is an easy-to-miss side event in the DLC.
In The Awakened King DLC, there are multiple ending choices.
To get the 'One True Ending', you must make a specific choice regarding the King's crown.
Check guides for the exact dialogue/item choices needed.
warnings: Missable — if you make the wrong choice you must reroll to try again.

steps: The Ritualist is unlocked in The Awakened King DLC.
Find the Ragged Poppet item in the DLC areas.
Bring it to Wallace in Ward 13 to unlock the Ritualist Archetype.

achievements.name: You Shall Pass
achievements.description: Acquire a Reward from the Bridge Warden.

steps: In The Awakened King DLC, run the route from Forlorn Coast to Drowned Wren without provoking the Fae. Do not aggro the Fae enemies you meet on the way — there are three places where they appear as petrified stone statues.
Pass through the gate and look into the large factory room on the left, but do not enter it or join the fight. A Fae and Dran brawl there as part of the Bridge Warden's event.
Continue straight ahead and climb the ladders to the top, where you find the Mournful Promenade world stone and the Bridge Warden.
Before approaching, aim down the sights of a long gun at him: a red reticle means you have angered him and he will attack, a yellow reticle means he is still neutral.
If you stayed out of the fight he says 'You did not resist' instead, and you can interact with him and exhaust his dialogue. He then hands over the Bridge Warden's Crest ring.
warnings: Killing Fae or joining the factory/foundry brawl turns the Bridge Warden hostile and locks the trophy.
Returning to the area later and clearing enemies can flip the Warden back to hostile — claim the ring before you fight anything else.
Talking to the Zealot at the start of the map for the Band of the Fanatic has been reported to make the Warden attack you.
A liquid-escape glitch that forced him to talk regardless of hostility has been patched out.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Summoned minions are risky here — they can attack something mid-run and fail the attempt.

steps: Play through The Forgotten Kingdom DLC from start to finish.
Complete the main storyline set in the new Yaesha area.

achievements.name: Thank You For Being a Friend

steps: Run The Forgotten Kingdom DLC and talk to the Pan named Walt at each of the five locations where he appears.
Defeat the final boss of the DLC, then return and talk to Walt one last time.
warnings: Talking to Walt while Cherished Fracture is equipped permanently voids this achievement for that run.
Co-op: it was host-only before the 1 May 2024 patch; it now pops for the host and all partners.

steps: In The Forgotten Kingdom DLC, you're presented with a major moral choice.
Make the 'difficult' choice — this is the less obvious/harder path.
warnings: Missable — if you choose the other option, you must reroll the DLC.

steps: The Invoker is unlocked in The Forgotten Kingdom DLC.
Find the Spirit Staff Old Growth item in the DLC.
Bring it to Wallace in Ward 13 to unlock the Invoker Archetype.
In The Forgotten Kingdom DLC, find three hidden crossbow parts scattered across the area.
Combine them to create the Trinity Crossbow.
Each part is in a separate hidden location — explore thoroughly.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The crossbow parts are well hidden. Use the interactive map or a video guide to find all three.

steps: Play through The Dark Horizon DLC storyline from start to finish.
Complete the main quest in the new N'Erud area.
In The Dark Horizon DLC, find Spark (unit 1074-S3) in the Agronomy Sector / Withered Necropolis on N'Erud. She relocates every time you reload the zone, so reload until she appears.
Talk to her and choose to invite her to Earth. She accepts, but mentions a voice preventing her return.
Defeat the final boss of the DLC, then talk to Spark again. She reboots, so talk again until she agrees to follow you.
She is usually found asleep in the corner of the room beside the Nanoplated Set, near the Dilapidated Auditorium crystal.
Reload Ward 13 until she arrives; she then sets up shop next to Dwell selling the Alloy Extractor.
warnings: Spark reboots several times after the final boss before she will agree to follow you — keep talking to her until she accepts.
Reloading Ward 13 (or leaving and rejoining a co-op session) is often needed before she shows up.
Reportedly you can skip almost the entire chain by joining a host's Ward just before they craft the last item.
Turning the purple pillars back to yellow is rumoured to be required, but this is unconfirmed.

achievements.name: B.O.T.
achievements.description: Find the Good in the Prototype.

steps: Collect all four Prototype parts. Head: straight after the trolley crashes behind you in Agronomy Sector. Arm: after flying over the big canyon full of purple goop, in a cave by a ghost with a blue web. Claw: end of a bridge in the Withered Necropolis, west of the Gardener. Memory core: in the Withered Necropolis, float down and underneath the main area above the Gardener.
Inspect the memory core in your inventory and press the interact button until it rotates from red/orange to blue.
Return to the bottom of the Agronomy Sector canyon (the same area as the arm). On the west side is a tunnel into the cliff containing the repairable Prototype.
Apply all four parts and let the conversation play out to the end.
warnings: Inspecting the memory core is mandatory. If you hand it over uninspected, the achievement is voided and cannot be recovered on that run.

steps: The Warden is unlocked in The Dark Horizon DLC.
Find the required Engram item in the DLC area.
Bring it to Wallace in Ward 13 to unlock the Warden Archetype.
In The Dark Horizon DLC, clear the two boss dungeons before anything else. On the fast-travel map these are the two dungeons drawn with a line running to the world boss arena.
Avoid going straight to the world boss — that route voids the achievement.
After clearing the dungeons, shoot the floating diamonds that beam with light, then talk to each one. There are two of them.
Defeat the world boss.
Return to the Gardener and exhaust that dialogue. You learn he is the Custodian and he tells you what happened to the Dryzr.
warnings: Rushing the world boss while skipping the two boss dungeons voids the achievement.
Co-op: it can pop off-host, but often not until minutes later, or when you leave the multiplayer session.
Players report having to talk to the Gardener in specific spots at each dungeon and crystal before the end; the main written solution leaves this out.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You must have met the Custodian in the base game N'Erud first. Then revisit them in The Dark Horizon.
